verses.text: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.
verses.title: In Step with God

verses.text: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart.”
But Ruth replied, “Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.
